Welcome back to our biweekly update!

PRODUCT
➡️ The most recent mainnet release was v0.1.11.
➡️ Added slippage limits for TP/SL/trigger orders.
➡️ Rework of loss refund mechanism: accounts can now receive a maximum of 1 loss refund per week (previously 3 per day), and loss refunds will only be processed when the loss refund pool balance is >5000 USDC (previously >100 USDC).
➡️ Added shareouts to the leaderboard.
➡️ More listing engine improvements.
➡️ Modifications to read API to be compatible with CoinGecko / CoinMarketCap reporting requirements.
